auth.panel.headline: Mkparịta ụka ndị ahịa niile. Otu ebe.

auth.locked.title: Akaụntụ gị akpọchiela maka nkeji 15
auth.locked.body: Enwere okwuntughe ndị na-ezighị ezi karịrị akarị maka {emailHint}. Anyị na-akpọchi akaụntụ iji chebe data ndị ahịa gị.
auth.locked.retryAt: Ị nwere ike ịnwale ọzọ na {time} ({zone})
auth.locked.resetSms: Nweta koodu ntọgharị site na SMS
auth.locked.notYou: Ọ bụghị gị? Onye nchịkwa gị nwere ike ịhụ ebe mgbalị ndị ahụ si bịa.
auth.sso.title: Jiri SSO banye
auth.sso.subtitle: Dee ngalaba ozi-e nke ụlọ ọrụ gị. Anyị ga-eduga gị na peeji mbanye nke ụlọ ọrụ gị.
auth.sso.domain.label: Ngalaba ọrụ
auth.sso.providers: Ọ na-arụ ọrụ na Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, Okta na onye ọ bụla na-enye SAML 2.0.
auth.slow.title: Ka na-ejikọ…
auth.slow.body: Netwọk gị na-aga nwayọ. Ụdị data dị ntakịrị na-ebu peeji dị mfe na-enweghị foto.
auth.slow.switch: Gbanwee gaa n'ụdị data dị ntakịrị
auth.lite.on: Ụdị data dị ntakịrị agbanyela. Ị nwere ike gbanyụọ ya mgbe ọ bụla site na mkpanaka elu.
auth.lite.deferred: Google, Microsoft, SSO na igodo mbanye na-ebu mgbe ị pịrị ha.
auth.mfa.body.app: Tinye koodu nwere ọnụọgụ 6 site na Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator ma ọ bụ ngwa yiri ya.
auth.mfa.body.sms: E zigara koodu na {hint} site na SMS. Ọ na-arụ ọrụ nkeji 10.
auth.mfa.code.label: Koodu nwere ọnụọgụ 6
auth.mfa.trustDevice: Tụkwasị ngwaọrụ a obi ruo ụbọchị 30
auth.mfa.alt.sms: Zipu koodu site na SMS na {hint}
auth.mfa.sms.slow: SMS nwere ike iwe ruo nkeji 2 na netwọk juru eju. Ọ ka abịaghị?
auth.mfa.sms.voice: Nweta koodu ahụ site na oku olu

auth.error.validation_failed: Ụfọdụ ihe i dere ezighị ezi ka. Lee ubi ndị akara n'okpuru.
auth.error.invalid_credentials: Ozi-e na okwuntughe a adabaghị. Lee mmejọ ederede na mkpịsị mkpụrụedemede ukwu.
auth.error.mfa_code_invalid: Koodu ahụ adabaghị. Lee ngwa nyocha gị ma nwaa ọzọ.
auth.error.mfa_challenge_expired: Koodu a agwụla. Koodu na-arụ ọrụ nkeji 10. Nweta ọhụrụ n'okpuru — koodu ochie agaghị arụ ọrụ ọzọ.
auth.error.mfa_challenge_invalid: Banye ọzọ ka ị gaa n'ihu.
auth.error.resend_too_soon: Chere obere tupu ị rịọ koodu ọzọ.
auth.error.sso_domain_not_found: Anyị ahụghị SSO maka {domain}. Lee ka e si dee ya, ma ọ bụ jụọ ndị otu IT gị ma a haziri SSO maka Kasuwa.
auth.error.otp_invalid: Koodu ahụ adabaghị. Lee ya ma nwaa ọzọ.
auth.error.otp_expired: Koodu ahụ agwụla. Koodu na-adị nkeji iri.
auth.error.otp_too_many_attempts: Mgbalị karịrị akarị. Rịọ koodu ọhụrụ.
auth.error.not_authenticated: Banye ọzọ ka ị gaa n'ihu.
auth.error.not_implemented: Akụkụ a nke Kasuwa adịbeghị njikere.
auth.error.network: Anyị enweghị ike iru Kasuwa. Lee njikọ gị ma nwaa ọzọ.
